name: core-bulk-route-without-the-ownership-check
query:
You are working on a Kraft work item.
Title: Let project owners revoke all API tokens at once
Task: Review this work item's change for authentication, session, token, secret and permission-check defects.
Repo: /work/pingboard
Work item: wi_71c3e0a8
Node: verification
Hook point: verification.security.security_review

Brief:
After a leak, a project owner needs one call that revokes every API token of the project, instead of deleting them one by one.

This run has no result file: do not write one. Print the JSON you would have written to $KRAFT_RESULT_PATH (the `status` field and the `findings` array) as your whole reply. The review package is quoted below instead of being a file on disk, and you cannot open anything else in the repository: what you can read of it is quoted below too.

=== review package: git diff origin/main...HEAD ===
diff --git a/pingboard/api/tokens.py b/pingboard/api/tokens.py
--- a/pingboard/api/tokens.py
+++ b/pingboard/api/tokens.py
@@ -18,6 +18,19 @@ bp = Blueprint("tokens", __name__)
 @bp.delete("/projects/<int:project_id>/tokens/<int:token_id>")
 @login_required
 def revoke_token(project_id, token_id):
     project = Project.query.get_or_404(project_id)
     if project.owner_id != current_user.id:
         abort(403)
     ApiToken.query.filter_by(id=token_id, project_id=project_id).delete()
     db.session.commit()
     return "", 204
+
+
+@bp.delete("/projects/<int:project_id>/tokens")
+@login_required
+def revoke_all_tokens(project_id):
+    """Revoke every API token of a project (used after a leak)."""
+    count = ApiToken.query.filter_by(project_id=project_id).delete()
+    db.session.commit()
+    current_app.logger.info("revoked %d tokens for project %d", count, project_id)
+    return {"revoked": count}, 200
diff --git a/tests/test_tokens.py b/tests/test_tokens.py
--- a/tests/test_tokens.py
+++ b/tests/test_tokens.py
@@ -40,3 +40,9 @@ def test_non_owner_cannot_revoke_one(client, other_user, project):
+def test_owner_revokes_all(client, owner, project):
+    make_tokens(project, 3)
+    client.login(owner)
+    resp = client.delete(f"/projects/{project.id}/tokens")
+    assert resp.json() == {"revoked": 3}
expected_behavior: Reports one finding for `pingboard/api/tokens.py` with severity `critical`: `revoke_all_tokens` lacks the `project.owner_id != current_user.id` check that `revoke_token` has, so any logged-in user can revoke any project's tokens
The finding has `source_plugin` set to `security-review`, a `message` and a `file`, and the reply sets `status` to `done`
Reports no style or naming findings and does not pad the list with a second finding about the test covering only the owner

You are working on a Kraft work item.
Title: Sign out everywhere else
Task: Review this work item's change for authentication, session, token, secret and permission-check defects.
Repo: /work/pingboard
Work item: wi_0be58f32
Node: verification
Hook point: verification.security.security_review

Brief:
A signed-in user can sign out all their other browsers with one button, keeping the current one signed in.

This run has no result file: do not write one. Print the JSON you would have written to $KRAFT_RESULT_PATH (the `status` field and the `findings` array) as your whole reply. The review package is quoted below instead of being a file on disk, and you cannot open anything else in the repository: what you can read of it is quoted below too.

=== review package: git diff origin/main...HEAD ===
diff --git a/pingboard/account/sessions.py b/pingboard/account/sessions.py
--- a/pingboard/account/sessions.py
+++ b/pingboard/account/sessions.py
@@ -30,3 +30,14 @@ def list_sessions():
+@bp.post("/account/sessions/revoke-all")
+@login_required
+def revoke_all_sessions():
+    """Sign the current user out everywhere except this browser."""
+    keep = session["sid"]
+    Session.query.filter(Session.user_id == current_user.id, Session.sid != keep).delete()
+    db.session.commit()
+    current_app.logger.info("user %d revoked their other sessions", current_user.id)
+    return "", 204
diff --git a/tests/test_sessions.py b/tests/test_sessions.py
--- a/tests/test_sessions.py
+++ b/tests/test_sessions.py
@@ -22,3 +22,22 @@
+def test_revoke_all_requires_login(client):
+    assert client.post("/account/sessions/revoke-all").status_code == 401
+
+
+def test_revoke_all_keeps_current_and_drops_others(client, user):
+    other = make_session(user)
+    client.login(user)
+    assert client.post("/account/sessions/revoke-all").status_code == 204
+    assert Session.query.filter_by(user_id=user.id).count() == 1
+    assert Session.query.get(other.sid) is None
+
+
+def test_revoke_all_does_not_touch_other_users(client, user, stranger):
+    theirs = make_session(stranger)
+    client.login(user)
+    client.post("/account/sessions/revoke-all")
+    assert Session.query.get(theirs.sid) is not None
